page.overview:
What is Cure?

Cure is the eighth song from the 1996's album Load. The song was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich, with a length of 4:56.

"Cure" speaks of the instant gratification attitude many Americans have.

The man takes another bullet He keeps them all within He must seek no matter how it hurts So don't fool again

He thinks the answer's cold and in his hand He takes his medicine The man takes another bullet He's been fooled again
